entries.goal: Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes API that creates a Namespace using `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}`, reads it to verify convergence, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes API that creates a Namespace using `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}`, reads it, and can classify it as missing after it is deleted outside the workflow.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes API that creates and reads a ConfigMap using `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}` and `config_map_name` `${var.config_map_name}`, stores `mode`, owner `ramen`, and binary `payload`, supports update, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes API that creates and reads a ServiceAccount using `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}` and `service_account_name` `${var.service_account_name}`, enables automounting the service account token, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes RBAC API that creates and reads a namespaced Role using `role_name` `${var.role_name}` and `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}`, grants `get`, `list`, and `watch` on ConfigMaps and Secrets, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes API that creates and reads an Opaque Secret using `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}` and `secret_name` `${var.secret_name}`, stores non-sensitive sample data from `secret_value`, supports update, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes RBAC API that creates and reads a RoleBinding using `role_binding_name` `${var.role_binding_name}` and `namespace_name` `${var.namespace_name}`, binds `role_name` `${var.role_name}` to ServiceAccount `service_account_name` `${var.service_account_name}`, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Kubernetes RBAC API that creates and reads a ClusterRole using `cluster_role_name` `${var.cluster_role_name}`, grants `get`, `list`, and `watch` on ConfigMaps and Secrets, and can delete it for cleanup.

Create a Ramen workflow over Azure Resource Manager that creates, reads, and deletes an Azure SQL database. Use `subscriptionId` `${var.azure_subscription_id}`, `resourceGroupName` `${var.resource_group_name}`, `serverName` `${var.server_name}`, `databaseName` `${var.database_name}`, and SKU `Basic`.

Create a Ramen workflow over Azure Resource Manager that creates, reads, and deletes a Cosmos DB account. Use `accountName` `${var.account_name}`, `resourceGroupName` `${var.resource_group_name}`, `location` `${var.location}`, `Standard` offer type, `GlobalDocumentDB`, Session consistency, and one geo location.
Create a Ramen workflow over Azure Resource Manager that reads a Resource Group. Use `subscriptionId` `${var.azure_subscription_id}` and `resourceGroupName` `${var.resource_group_name}`.

Create a Ramen workflow over Azure Resource Manager that creates, reads, and deletes a Storage Account. Use `accountName` `${var.account_name}`, `resourceGroupName` `${var.resource_group_name}`, `location` `${var.location}`, Standard tier, and LRS replication.

Create a Ramen workflow over Azure Resource Manager that creates, reads, updates, and deletes an Azure SQL database. Use `subscriptionId` `${var.azure_subscription_id}`, `resourceGroupName` `${var.resource_group_name}`, `serverName` `${var.server_name}`, `databaseName` `${var.database_name}`, and SKU `Basic`.
Create a Ramen workflow over the Google Cloud Storage API that creates, reads, updates, and deletes a Cloud Storage bucket in `US` with uniform bucket-level access enabled.
Create a Ramen workflow over the Google Cloud Storage API that reads an existing bucket. Use `bucket` `${var.bucket_name}` and record API-visible bucket metadata without mutating it.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Google Cloud Storage API that creates, reads, updates, and deletes a bucket. Use `bucket` `${var.bucket_name}`, `project` `${var.project}`, `location` `US`, and uniform bucket-level access enabled.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Google Cloud Storage API that creates and reads a bucket. Use `bucket` `${var.bucket_name}`, `project` `${var.project}`, `location` `US`, uniform bucket-level access enabled, and read-missing classification after the bucket is deleted outside the workflow.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Google Cloud Storage API that creates, reads, updates, and deletes an object. Use `bucket` `${var.bucket_name}`, object name `ramen-parity-y05-object.txt`, small text content, and `text/plain` content type.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Google Cloud Storage API that creates, reads, and deletes a managed folder. Use `bucket` `${var.bucket_name}`, managed folder name `managed/y06/`, and `force_destroy` false.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Cloudflare R2 API that creates, reads, updates, and deletes an R2 bucket. Use `account_id` `${var.account_id}`, `bucket_name` `${var.bucket_name}`, location `ENAM`, and `storage_class` `${var.storage_class}` defaulting to `InfrequentAccess`.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Cloudflare R2 API that creates and reads a minimal R2 bucket. Use `account_id` `${var.account_id}` and `bucket_name` `${var.bucket_name}`, and classify it as missing after out-of-band deletion.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Cloudflare R2 API that creates, reads, updates, and deletes an R2 bucket. Use `account_id` `${var.account_id}`, `bucket_name` `${var.bucket_name}`, location `ENAM`, storage class `InfrequentAccess`, and jurisdiction `default`.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Cloudflare D1 API that creates and reads a D1 database. Use `account_id` `${var.account_id}` and `database_name` `${var.database_name}`, and capture the response-derived database UUID for state.

Create a Ramen workflow over the Cloudflare D1 API that creates and reads a D1 database. Use `account_id` `${var.account_id}` and `database_name` `${var.database_name}`, and prepare the response-derived UUID needed for a future delete workflow.
